description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Fiend enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
